description: Location-aware platform where the map is the primary interface. Industry brain defines what is being discovered or tracked on the map. This core defines how location, navigation, and proximity work.

relationships: Place has a Location and belongs to a Category
Pin is placed by User on the map — saved or custom
Route connects two or more Locations
Review belongs to User, written about a Place
CheckIn belongs to User at a Place
Tracking belongs to a moving entity (driver, shipment, delivery) with a live Location
Address is a resolved Location — street, city, coordinates
Search returns Places near a Location
Notification belongs to User, triggered by proximity or tracking events

mvp.description: Core map — discover places, search by location, view detail, get directions.
primary_flows: Open app → map loads at current location → browse nearby places → tap pin → view place detail → get directions
Search location or place → results on map and list → tap result → detail → directions
Save place → view saved places → navigate to saved place

interaction_patterns: Map pins cluster at low zoom — expand on zoom in
Place detail slides up from bottom as sheet — map stays visible behind
Current location button — tap to re-centre map on user
Pin tap — quick preview card slides up — tap card to open full detail
Route preview — map zooms to fit entire route before starting navigation
Navigation instruction — large text, icon, and distance remaining
Long press on map — drop custom pin — option to save or get directions

primary_flows: Check in to place → add photo → share → view check-in history
Track live location of entity → view on map → receive arrival notification

Download offline map → navigate without internet connection
